Welcome. This is a small site about the **Palmer penguins**: three species measured at Palmer
Station, Antarctica, included in base R as `datasets::penguins` (R ≥ 4.5).

Head to the **[analysis](analysis.qmd)** for the figures and a summary table.

## Reports

Quarto builds this index from the `reports/` folder, so a new page there shows up here on the next
render with nothing to edit.

::: {#reports}
:::

> This is the finished Day-2 project: the `.qmd` pages from `day2-projects/`, plus the `_quarto.yml`,
> the `_brand.yml`, the `reports/_metadata.yml`, and the `freeze` setting that turn them into a
> navigable, branded, reproducible website. Open it to compare, or use it as the ready starting point
> for whichever part you did not finish.
